articles.title: How to make your profit and loss account and balance sheet
articles.summary: Make a profit and loss account and balance sheet in Nivesh Sahayak: period, trial balance heads, stock, adjustments like depreciation and capital, then print.

articles.title: How to make the final accounts from a trial balance file
articles.card: Final accounts from a Tally or Excel trial balance
articles.summary: Drop a trial balance from Tally, Busy or Excel on profit-loss.niveshsahayak.in and get the balance sheet, profit and loss, notes and ratios in Schedule III or T format.
